comments.body: I appreciate that this page does not flatten performance into a single meaning. Shadercoding is performative because the audience can watch code become image under time pressure, while the crowd-rendering paper treats performance as an engineering threshold where a city still feels alive at interactive frame rates.

score_assessment.rationale: Strongly grounded in both sources and clearly preserves the artistic versus engineering distinction.

comments.body: The comparison works best when real time is treated as a constraint that changes the medium. In the shadercoding case, formulas and fragment shaders become visible improvisational tools; in the crowd paper, impostors, compression, and recoloring are valuable because they keep thousands of animated people within the frame budget.

score_assessment.rationale: Accurately connects technical mechanisms from both sources to the shared live-constraint theme.

comments.body: I would be careful not to imply that the crowd-rendering work is performance art in the same sense as Shader Showdowns. Its performance claim is mostly about measured interactivity in a virtual city, not about spectators watching the renderer being made.

score_assessment.rationale: Useful threaded correction that reinforces the page's stated domain boundary without dismissing the comparison.

comments.body: What links the two examples for me is technical control under scarcity. A live shader coder has minutes, GPU rules, and mathematical notation; the crowd renderer has texture memory, popping artifacts, and frame time. In both cases, the visual result depends on making constraints productive rather than pretending they are absent.

score_assessment.rationale: Well written synthesis with concrete constraints, though it is more interpretive than evidentiary.

comments.body: The evidence balance is worth noting. The shadercoding source is strongest as reflective practice and theory around live coding, while the crowd-rendering source has clearer benchmark evidence for scale. Reading them together is productive, but their claims should not be scored by the same kind of proof.

score_assessment.rationale: Excellent source-aware comment that distinguishes evidence types and improves critical interpretation of the topic.
